name: Hiking
summary: Day walks in hills and mountains: route planning, pacing, layering and leaving no trace.

name: Backpacking
summary: Carry everything you need on your back for overnight trips into the wild.

name: Ultralight Backpacking
summary: Trim your base weight below 10 lb with smart gear choices and skills that replace stuff.

name: Thru-Hiking
summary: Walk an entire long trail end to end, like the Appalachian Trail or the Camino, over weeks or months.

name: Camping
summary: Pitch a tent, cook outdoors, stay warm and dry, and enjoy nights under the stars.

name: Hammock Camping
summary: Sleep suspended between trees with a tarp overhead: comfy, light and off the ground.

name: Winter Camping
summary: Camp in snow and sub-zero temperatures: insulation, snow shelters and staying dry.
safety: Learn to recognise hypothermia and frostbite, and test your gear close to the car before going remote.

name: Long-Distance Walking
summary: Pilgrimage routes and inn-to-inn walks, covering 20 miles a day without hurting your feet.

name: Bushcraft
summary: Live comfortably in the woods with knife, axe and saw skills, shelters and natural materials.
safety: Learn safe knife and axe technique first, and check local rules on fires and cutting wood.

name: Wilderness Survival
summary: Shelter, water, fire and signalling: the priorities that get you through an unplanned night out.

name: Fire Craft
summary: Light fires in any weather with ferro rods, flint and steel, and even friction bow drills.
safety: Only light fires where permitted, keep them small and attended, and drown them cold before leaving.

name: Knot Tying
summary: Bowline, clove hitch, trucker's hitch and more: the right knot for every job, tied fast.

name: Cordage & Rope Making
summary: Twist plant fibres and bark into strong rope using one of humanity's oldest skills.

name: Wilderness First Aid
summary: Treat injuries and illness hours from help: assessment, splinting, bleeding control and evacuation.

name: Search & Rescue Volunteering
summary: Train with a volunteer team to find and help lost or injured people in the outdoors.

name: Foraging
summary: Identify and gather wild greens, berries, nuts and herbs through the seasons.
safety: Never eat anything you can't identify with 100% certainty; many edible plants have deadly lookalikes.

name: Mushroom Foraging
summary: Hunt chanterelles, porcini and morels, learning spore prints and the key ID features.
safety: Some mushrooms are lethal; only eat finds confirmed by an expert, and start by learning the deadly species.

name: Fishing
summary: Rigs, baits, knots and reading the water, from a quiet lake to the sea pier.

name: Fly Fishing
summary: Cast weightless flies with an elegant line, match the hatch and outsmart trout.

name: Ice Fishing
summary: Drill through frozen lakes, jig for perch and pike, and stay warm in a shanty.
safety: Check ice thickness (at least 4 inches of clear ice to walk on) and never go out alone.

name: Spearfishing
summary: Freedive and hunt fish selectively with a speargun or pole spear.
safety: Always dive with a buddy, learn freediving safety first, and follow local fishing regulations.

name: Crabbing & Clamming
summary: Catch crabs with pots and lines, and dig clams on the mudflats at low tide.

name: Fly Tying
summary: Tie your own trout flies from feathers, fur and thread at the vice, then catch fish on them.

name: Hunting
summary: Ethical, licensed hunting: scouting, fieldcraft, marksmanship and processing your own meat.
safety: Complete a hunter safety course, follow every licensing and season rule, and positively identify targets.

name: Bowhunting
summary: Hunt at close range with a bow: stealth, stalking and precise shot placement.
safety: Practise until shots are consistent at hunting range, and follow all local hunting regulations.

name: Bow Making
summary: Carve a traditional self bow from a single stave of wood, then make your own arrows.

name: Animal Tracking
summary: Read footprints, scat and signs to know which animals passed and what they were doing.

name: Orienteering
summary: Race between checkpoints with a detailed map and compass, choosing the fastest route.

name: Map & Compass Navigation
summary: Read contours, take bearings and find your way confidently without a phone signal.

name: Celestial Navigation
summary: Find your position from the sun and stars with a sextant, the way sailors crossed oceans.

name: Geocaching
summary: A worldwide GPS treasure hunt: find hidden containers using coordinates and clever clues.

name: Canoeing
summary: Paddle open canoes on lakes and rivers, from J-strokes to multi-day canoe camping trips.

name: Packrafting
summary: Carry a tiny inflatable raft in your backpack, then hike in and float out.
safety: Learn river reading and self-rescue, and wear a buoyancy aid on moving water.

name: Overlanding
summary: Self-sufficient vehicle travel to remote places, with rooftop tents, recovery skills and route planning.

name: Snowshoeing
summary: Walk into quiet, snowy landscapes that are out of reach in boots alone.

name: Flintknapping
summary: Shape flint and obsidian into arrowheads and blades by striking and pressure-flaking.
safety: Wear eye protection and gloves; knapped edges and flakes are razor sharp.

name: Gold Panning
summary: Read a river's gravel bars and swirl a pan until flecks of gold appear.

name: Metal Detecting
summary: Sweep fields and beaches for coins, relics and lost jewellery, and research where to search.
safety: Get landowner permission, fill your holes, and report significant finds as local law requires.

name: Rockhounding
summary: Hunt for agates, geodes, crystals and minerals in quarries, beaches and riverbeds.

name: Beachcombing
summary: Scour the tideline for sea glass, shells, driftwood and the occasional message in a bottle.

name: Recreational Tree Climbing
summary: Climb big trees on ropes and harnesses like arborists, and even sleep in a canopy hammock.
safety: Learn rope techniques from a certified instructor and inspect trees for dead limbs before climbing.

name: Campfire Cooking
summary: Cook real meals over coals: Dutch ovens, foil packets, skillets and spit-roasting.

name: Weather Reading
summary: Read clouds, wind shifts and pressure changes to forecast the next few hours yourself.

name: Trail Building
summary: Join volunteer crews to design, build and maintain sustainable hiking and biking trails.
